title: Kickoff does not fade between Transparent and Opaque like the panel does
line: Kickoff and other panel popups now fade between translucent and opaque together with an adaptive-opacity panel instead of switching instantly.
explanation: When an adaptive panel touches a window it asks its applets for opaque popups, and the panel itself fades its solid background in over Kirigami's long duration. Popups (Dialog and AppletPopup) only swapped the image path of their single background SVG between dialogs/background and solid/dialogs/background, so a pinned Kickoff turned opaque in one frame while the panel was still fading. The shared DialogBackground now keeps the real frame for margins and mask, and while the window is shown it cross-fades a translucent and a solid frame with the same duration and easing as the panel; hidden popups still switch instantly.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/core: fade popups between translucent and solid

Popups switched between their translucent and solid backgrounds in a
single frame when the panel's adaptive opacity changed, while the panel
fades. The dialog background now cross-fades the two like panels do.

BUG: 518057

patches.diff:
From 96c2956fba11561842274f1d5b223dd2d0f60e68 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:32:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] declarativeimports/core: fade popups between translucent and
 solid

Popups switched between their translucent and solid backgrounds in a
single frame when the panel's adaptive opacity changed, while the panel
fades. The dialog background now cross-fades the two like panels do.

BUG: 518057
---
 .../core/private/DialogBackground.qml         | 46 ++++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 44 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/core/private/DialogBackground.qml b/src/declarativeimports/core/private/DialogBackground.qml
index 767812ca9..bf6c06588 100644
--- a/src/declarativeimports/core/private/DialogBackground.qml
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/core/private/DialogBackground.qml
@@ -6,12 +6,54 @@
 
 import QtQuick
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 /*!
  * Internal type used by DialogBackground in plasmaquick to load the actual
  * background SVG.
  */
-KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+Item {
+    id: root
+
     anchors.fill: parent
-    imagePath: "widgets/background"
+
+    property alias imagePath: frame.imagePath
+    property alias enabledBorders: frame.enabledBorders
+    readonly property alias mask: frame.mask
+    readonly property alias fixedMargins: frame.fixedMargins
+    readonly property alias inset: frame.inset
+
+    readonly property string translucentPath: imagePath.startsWith("solid/") ? imagePath.slice(6) : imagePath
+    readonly property real solidTarget: imagePath.startsWith("solid/") ? 1 : 0
+    property real solidOpacity: solidTarget
+    readonly property bool fading: solidOpacity !== solidTarget
+
+    // Fade between the translucent and solid backgrounds like panels do
+    Behavior on solidOpacity {
+        enabled: root.Window.visibility !== Window.Hidden
+        NumberAnimation {
+            duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
+            easing.type: Easing.OutCubic
+        }
+    }
+
+    KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+        id: frame
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: !root.fading
+        imagePath: "widgets/background"
+    }
+    KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: root.fading
+        enabledBorders: frame.enabledBorders
+        imagePath: root.fading ? root.translucentPath : ""
+    }
+    KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: root.fading
+        opacity: root.solidOpacity
+        enabledBorders: frame.enabledBorders
+        imagePath: root.fading ? "solid/" + root.translucentPath : ""
+    }
 }
--

With the fix Kickoff is still translucent at +0.4 s and becomes opaque together with the panel.
